requirements.name: Подключения провайдеров
requirements.acceptance: Оператор создаёт/отключает connection; неизвестный provider/неразрешённый endpoint отклоняется; disable не удаляет историю.

requirements.name: Секреты и managed authorization
requirements.acceptance: Write-only ключ/authorization, own encrypted key, generation; API/log/export/browser storage не раскрывают secrets.

requirements.name: Проверка возможностей
requirements.acceptance: Publication требует actual proof точных account/model/generation/adapter/capabilities; catalog alone не sufficient.

requirements.name: Версии виртуальных моделей
requirements.acceptance: Создание slug/draft, CAS save, immutable revision, publication/rollback/archive; active runs не меняют snapshot.

requirements.name: Маршрутизация и fallback
requirements.acceptance: Ordered fallback только explicit policy и known nonacceptance; никаких смешанных streams; pinned_test один deployment.

requirements.name: Повтор и неопределённый исход
requirements.acceptance: Одинаковый principal/key/payload даёт readback, changed payload conflict; restart/timeout не повторяет unknown I/O.

requirements.name: Inference API
requirements.acceptance: Models/chat completions/stateless responses, text/stream/function tools/JSON при qualified capability; неподдержанное явно rejected.

requirements.name: Подписки и квоты
requirements.acceptance: Own managed login/revoke, отдельная плата за период и quota observations с freshness; недоступная quota null.

requirements.name: Фактическая модель и trace
requirements.acceptance: Request связывает frozen profile и все attempts; actual model confidence виден; provider alias substitution не hidden.

requirements.name: Usage и цены
requirements.acceptance: Trusted category facts × immutable rate snapshot; cached/reasoning не двойной счёт, missing usage/pricing unknown.

requirements.name: Реальные расходы и подписки
requirements.acceptance: Confirmed receipt заменяет связанную estimate; duplicate charge/subscription не меняет totals; correction append-only.

requirements.name: Бюджет и предупреждения
requirements.acceptance: Atomic reserve по всем scopes до I/O, unknown удерживает reserve; thresholds уведомляют один раз; actual overrun не обрезается.

requirements.name: Статистика по разрезам
requirements.acceptance: UTC range + timezone, dimensions/client/project/user/model/provider, known/unknown counts, snapshot freshness и rebuild.

requirements.name: Качество обслуживания
requirements.acceptance: Success/error/cancel/fallback rates, latency/TTFT, availability/quota с sample sizes и explicit denominators.

requirements.name: Экспорт
requirements.acceptance: Authorized bounded CSV/JSON соответствует dashboard snapshot; decimal/null semantics и formula safety сохранены.

requirements.name: Диагностика
requirements.acceptance: Own health, bounded metrics, redacted logs, alerts budget/unknown/lag/provider; telemetry failure не стирает facts.

requirements.name: Сравнение для dev/test
requirements.acceptance: Frozen dataset/runner/scorers/pinned revisions без cache/fallback; evidence, actual cost и cancel/restart без дублирования.

requirements.name: Права и атрибуция
requirements.acceptance: Central human/service/client principals различаются; server grants защищают direct URLs, requests, stats и artifacts.

requirements.name: Отзыв
requirements.acceptance: Revoked/expired central session/PAT/key/generation запрещает новый admission/attempt; никакого credential fallback.

requirements.name: Endpoint и tools boundary
requirements.acceptance: SSRF/redirect/private allowlist, payload caps; Hub не исполняет shell/browser/caller function tools.

requirements.name: Интеграция Base и Admin
requirements.acceptance: Один AI config owner; transition contracts/rollback, own auth/catalog/nav; прежний runtime не переключается по docs.

requirements.name: Сохранность и restore
requirements.acceptance: Own DB/vault/keys/provenance restore в изолированный target; нет external I/O/повторного dispatch; сверяются balances/dedupe.

requirements.name: Аудит управления
requirements.acceptance: Mutation + append-only audit атомарны, object/revision/actor/reason; secret bodies и transcripts не попадают в audit.

requirements.name: UI сценарии
requirements.acceptance: Provider/models/requests/analytics/expenses/budgets/evaluations со states, CAS, preserved drafts, readable provenance.

requirements.name: Валюты и отображение
requirements.acceptance: Per-currency totals, confirmed/estimated/unknown/reserved отдельно; subscription allocation не повторное cash списание.

requirements.name: Ошибки и ограничения
requirements.acceptance: Typed errors/retry-after/context/output/capability bounds, deadlined attempts; no silent truncation/downgrade.

requirements.name: Consistency
requirements.acceptance: Facts/settlement/dedupe/revisions атомарны; concurrent admissions/duplicate events не меняют accepted totals.

requirements.name: Recovery
requirements.acceptance: Restart/cancel/ambiguous outcomes readback сохраняет intent и reserves; нет слепого paid replay.

requirements.name: Performance bounds
requirements.acceptance: Controlled load baseline: 20 concurrent requests, own overhead p95≤50ms; 90-day/100k rows stats p95≤2s; receipt включает hardware.

requirements.name: Reproducible build
requirements.acceptance: Exact Base SHA, locked manifests, isolated own resources; source/build/image/served identity различаются.

requirements.name: Privacy и retention
requirements.acceptance: Default no transcripts, encrypted bounded replay buffer, evaluation TTL, own deletion/archival сохраняет billing identity.

requirements.name: Responsive/a11y
requirements.acceptance: Base shell/themes, keyboard/focus, readable stats/currency и errors; 375/1440/1920/2560, no body overflow.

requirements.name: Contract compatibility
requirements.acceptance: Versioned contracts, old clients tested; destructive schema/transport change требует version/migration; no unsupported field dropping.

requirements.name: Evidence integrity
requirements.acceptance: Точный source/Base/image/target identity + live consumer/provider сценарии; mock/build/health не substitute user outcome.

tests.scenario: Создать connection с новым display name/ID; permitted endpoint succeeds; неизвестный adapter и private redirect denied; disable сохраняет history.
Записать/сменить/revoke synthetic credential; искать canary secret в API, logs, traces, browser storage, exports; wrong-key restore denied.
Catalog metadata без proof publication denied; exact proof succeeds; смена generation/model/draft/adapter или expired proof вновь denied.
Два concurrent drafts: один CAS succeeds, второй 412 с сохранённым draft; pointer rollback не меняет frozen request; duplicate slug denied.
Controlled primary 429/no acceptance и reserve secondary дают две attempts; connect-before-send fallback; timeout/5xx-after-send и output fragment не fallback.
Один key/payload повторить до/после restart; dispatch count=1; different payload/principal conflict/denied; expired payload readback не resend.
Public chat/Responses normal/stream/tools/continuation/JSON через controlled server; case-sensitive args retained; unsupported field/native tool/stateful request rejected before I/O.
Own subscription login/cancel/logout generations; invalidated authorization не возобновляется; quota absent null; recurring payment не множится по calls.
Provider actual model отличается от requested alias: показать both/verification; pinned run incomparable; virtual response slug remains caller name.
Вычислить synthetic cached/reasoning example exact decimal; unknown category/rate дает unknown; invalid negative counts rejected; stale price snapshot not rewritten.
Duplicate trusted receipt и subscription payment дают одну charge; late confirmation replaces estimate; refund creates correction; forged amount/status not accepted.
Два API instances параллельно reserving последний бюджет: ровно один dispatch; multiple scopes/currencies; warning dedupe; unknown holds; overrun visible.
Same authorized snapshot overview/breakdown/timeseries согласованы; late facts rebuild; timezone/DST/half-open boundary, empty confirmed vs source error различаются.
Dataset с completed/failed/cancelled/unknown/inprogress и zero traffic: exact denominators/sample counts/percentiles/TTFT, probes separate from user calls.
Client A пытается export B через прямой query/ID/cursor; deny. Decimal CSV value/null match JSON; formula text escaped; oversized export bounded.
Down ledger DB отказ до I/O; metrics collector failure не duplicate dispatch; lag/unknown alerts без high-cardinality labels и private bodies.
Одинаковые frozen cases/config на двух qualified pinned models, no fallback/cache; seed disclaimer; partial cancel/restart no repeated case calls, cost per actual attempt.
Human session, PAT read/write и inference key матрица; project binding spoofed body ignored/denied; protected direct route/details/cursors enforce backend grants.
Revoke/expire session/PAT/key/connection перед admission/next attempt и во время UI; no new I/O; no unexpected re-login/global credential fallback.
Allowlist local Ollama exact target работает; SSRF/DNS rebinding/redirect/proxy env denied; prompt tool call возвращён caller без local side effect.
Consumer на old endpoint и explicit opt-in Hub key; exact revision/generation mapped; cutover/rollback no duplicate inference or shared DB writes.
Backup synthetic DB+vault отделён от key; own isolated restore external_calls off; dedupe/unknown reserves/audit links equal; existing data target rejected.
Mutation и audit fail атомарно при DB failure; repeated idempotent operation не audit duplicates; no secret body/raw provider error in record.
Все routes loading/empty/error/403/404/partial и dirty/pending/412; screenshot + real API scenario; unavailable provider не empty success.
USD/EUR/zero/unknown + estimate then confirmation + fixed subscription: per-currency totals exact; no combined mixed currency or double allocation.
Context/output/schema deadline mismatch до I/O; 429 safe Retry-After; provider error redacted and distinct from invalid input; stream terminal not false success.
DB concurrency/dedupe/correction unique constraints и compare canonical amounts до/после aggregate rebuild; transaction rollback on partial write.
Crash before intent, after intent, after dispatch, before terminal commit; stable request IDs/reserves; reconcile without redispatch; cancellation not free unknown.
Exact-source isolated load fixture/hardware receipt, 20 concurrency, 100k rows: measure own overhead/statistics limits; slow provider separated; memory bounded.
Materialize pinned Base, verify clean revision; frozen dependency build/readback hashes; CI/local images use same toolchain, changes to lock fail frozen gate.
Advance TTL clock: replay payload/artifacts removed, dedupe/ledger keys retained; content denied after expiry, billing readback remains; no provider calls by TTL worker.
375/1440/1920/2560 across supported themes: keyboard tab/Escape/return focus, no horizontal body overflow; unknown expense accessible label and readable table.
Old supported client payloads retained, contract draft→generated parity, reject unsupported semantic fields; OpenAPI/schema compatibility and migration previous schema.
Final merged source/Base/image artifact hashes match served target; authenticate UI + actual provider/consumer checks; old screenshot/probe receipt rejected as current.

phases.name: Own foundation и trusted access
phases.outcome: Изолированное приложение принимает trusted principal, имеет own schema/audit и живые readiness/SSO проверки.

phases.name: Connection и virtual model lifecycle
phases.outcome: Synthetic provider подключён, capabilities проверены; draft публикует immutable revision через UI/API.

phases.name: Inference с financial ledger
phases.outcome: Реальный controlled upstream отвечает full/stream/tools через scoped Hub key, retries/fallback/budget/restart доказаны.

phases.name: Нужные внешние providers и subscriptions
phases.outcome: Каждый выбранный account/adapter qualified live; own auth и subscription/quota receipts проверены.

phases.name: Статистика, расходы и operational UI
phases.outcome: Сводки/разрезы/export совпадают с ledger; late facts, partial failures, multi-currency и thresholds проверены.

phases.name: Воспроизводимые model evaluations
phases.outcome: Одинаковый dataset на pinned profiles даёт проверяемые результаты, реальные расходы и cancel/recovery.

phases.name: Integration, restore и полный release gate
phases.outcome: Выбранный consumer проходит exact-target полный путь; own restore, rollout/rollback и итоговая приёмка доказаны.
